name: wani_cru_face
desc: Change only the face. The black pupils look downward, toward the bottom of the eyes, gazing down at something below its chin. The lips pull back into a wide sly grin that shows its teeth, jaws still closed. Do not change anything else at all: same head shape, spikes, arms, chest, body, goo column, puddle, colors, marble streaks, outline and pixel style.
